part.text:
All 27 tests in `tests/grep.rs` pass.

## What I implemented in `src/lib.rs`

**`Flags` struct** — replaced the empty placeholder with five booleans parsed from the `&[&str]` input in `Flags::new`:
- `line_numbers` (`-n`), `file_names` (`-l`), `ignore_case` (`-i`), `invert` (`-v`), `whole_line` (`-x`)

**`grep(pattern, flags, files)`** — for each file:
- Reads it with `std::fs::read_to_string(file)?` (the `?` propagates I/O errors via `anyhow`, which makes the nonexistent-file test return `Err`).
- Iterates `content.lines()` with 1-based line numbers.
- Matches via a `line_matches` helper: exact equality for `-x` (with `eq_ignore_ascii_case` under `-i`), otherwise substring `contains` (with lowercasing under `-i`).
- Emits a line when `invert != matched`. Output is built as `file:` (only when searching more than one file) + `line_number:` (only with `-n`) + the line.
- For `-l`, it tracks whether the file had any match and pushes the file name once at the end, so it takes precedence over `-n` and doesn't duplicate per match.

The only fix needed after the first run was an off-by-one: line numbers are 1-based, so I use `index + 1`.

No changes were needed to `Cargo.toml` (the `anyhow` dependency was already present) or to the tests.
